_readme: This is a provisioning contract, not a GitHub App manifest and not a running service.
No private key, webhook secret, installation token, evaluator endpoint, or App ID belongs in this repository.
Apply remains blocked until an independently reviewed external evaluator is deployed.

publisherIdentity.required: A dedicated GitHub App installed only on judeper/FSI-AgentGov

credentialContract.owner: owner GH_TOKEN or gh auth as judeper; used for repository/ruleset/probe reads and ruleset create/delete operations
credentialContract.app: runtime GitHub App JWT from App ID plus private key path or environment secret; used only for App identity/installation discovery and temporary installation-token creation
credentialContract.privateKey: never committed, persisted, logged, echoed, or sent to candidate code
credentialContract.webhookSecret: runtime secret only; validate timestamp, replay window, HMAC signature, event repository, installation, and delivery identity before evaluation

webhookSecurity.timestampSource: trusted receiver clock at receipt; GitHub supplies no signed timestamp header

mergeQueueRequirement.whenEnabled: Subscribe to merge_group and publish the same check from the dedicated App on merge_group.head_sha. A passing PR-head check is not a passing merge-group check.
mergeQueueRequirement.currentState: merge queue is not enabled by this plan

evaluationContract: Verify the signed webhook before processing it.
After signature validation, accept the fresh 256-bit operator challenge only through the authenticated evaluator control plane and capture the trusted receiver timestamp.
Capture event head SHA, base SHA, and base ref; reject if a live PR read differs before or after evaluation.
Read trusted policy and verifier material from the immutable event base SHA, never from the candidate head.
Read base and candidate trees by immutable SHA, classify both tree sides and complete pull-file records, and treat candidate bytes as data only.
Never check out, install, import, execute, or interpolate candidate content.
Publish success only after the complete verdict is successful and bind the check run to the exact evaluated SHA.
Encode nonce, repository, PR, head/base SHAs, immutable-base policy digest/version, verdict mode, and receiver timestamp in canonical external_id.
operatorVerification: The owner must record the App ID returned by GitHub and pass it explicitly to the ruleset script.
The owner credential and App credential are separate: owner auth performs ruleset plan/create/read/delete, while an App JWT proves the App identity and exact installation.

The owner must prove this is the App's only installation, enumerate installation repositories with a temporary installation token, require exactly judeper/FSI-AgentGov, verify exact permissions/events, and revoke the token.
The owner must prove ruleset integration_id equality and fresh evaluator check runs whose app.id equals that App ID.
Apply must create the ruleset before accepting one positive no-op PR and one negative same-name GitHub Actions spoof PR; both probes must be freshly evaluated and causally bound through external_id.
If any read-back field is unavailable or differs, the artifact gate remains blocked and non-enforced.
